description: This file defines the BadResponseException class within the GuzzleHttp exception namespace, representing an exception thrown for HTTP error responses (4xx or 5xx). It extends RequestException and adds methods related to response handling.

classes.name: BadResponseException
classes.description: An exception class for HTTP error responses, extending RequestException, indicating that an HTTP error (4xx, 5xx) occurred.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the exception with a message, request, response, previous throwable, and handler context.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Returns true indicating that this exception and its subclasses always have an associated response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the ResponseInterface associated with this exception, narrowing the parent's nullable return type.
